# Off-Piste Magazine

> > Off-Piste Magazine is a backcountry skiing publication covering avalanche safety, ski gear reviews, and mountain culture.

Founded with 16 years of print history, Off-Piste Mag has transitioned to digital while maintaining its focus on technical backcountry skiing content, gear testing, and avalanche education. The magazine covers key mountain regions including Colorado, Wyoming, Alaska, Idaho, and Montana, with gear from brands like Helly Hansen, Arc'teryx, Black Diamond, and G3.

## Key Topics

- Backcountry skiing
- Avalanche safety and education
- Ski touring and mountaineering
- Climbing skins maintenance
- Human factors and risk management
- Ski gear reviews and testing
- Avalanche transceivers and beacons
- Weak layer identification
- Winter weather forecasting
- Ski boot fitting
- PFAS-free outerwear
- Ski crampons
- Backcountry communication
- Terrain selection
- Mountain culture and films

- [Off-Piste Mag - backcoutry skiing, ski gear reviews and more](https://offpistemag.com/backcountry-skiing/the-mag): About page detailing Off-Piste Mag's 16-year print history & digital shift
- [Off-Piste Magazine - backcountry skiing, ski gear reviews and more](https://offpistemag.com): Homepage featuring latest backcountry ski gear reviews & mountain content
- [Off-Piste Magazine backcountry skiing blog and gear review](https://offpistemag.com/blog): Main blog feed with ski gear reviews, weather beta & backcountry news

## Avalanche Safety Education

- [Avalanche 101 - A low-tech approach to identifying common weak layers](https://offpistemag.com/weak-layers): Larry Goldie's low-tech guide to identifying avalanche weak layers
- [Avalanche Systems - Managing Your Human Factor](https://offpistemag.com/avalanche-systems-stock): Joe Stock's guide to personal avalanche safety systems & human factors
- [Avalanche safety tips](https://offpistemag.com/avalanche-safety): Guide to avalanche trip planning with morning meeting & terrain selection
- [Avalanche Safety - Communication in the Backcountry](https://offpistemag.com/communication): Guide to backcountry communication skills & managing human factors
- [Avalanche Hazard Rating - the problem vs. the hazard](https://offpistemag.com/whats-the-problem): Understanding avalanche problems vs hazard ratings for decision-making
- [Avalanche Transceiver Interference](https://offpistemag.com/avalanche-transciver-interference): Industry guidance on avoiding EMI with avalanche transceivers & electronics

## Gear Guides & Maintenance

- [Ski Boot Fitting 101 - 10 tips for a great fit](https://offpistemag.com/ski-boot-fitting-tips): Ten essential ski boot fitting tips including mondopoint sizing & shell fit
- [Ski Crampons and Boot Crampons for ski boots and ski mountaineering](https://offpistemag.com/crampons): Guide to ski & boot crampons for mountaineering from Dynafit, G3 & others
- [Climbing Skin Maintenance - Renew and refresh your skin glue](https://offpistemag.com/climbing-skins-maintenance-and-renewal): Rick Lui's climbing skin glue reactivation technique using iron method
- [Climbing Skins - Tips and tricks for backcountry climbing skins](https://offpistemag.com/climbing-skin-care): Essential climbing skin care tips for glue maintenance & field repair

## Gear Reviews & Industry News

- [Ortovox Diract Voice Avalanche Beacon - Off-Piste Mag Review](https://offpistemag.com/ortovox-diract-voice-avalanche-beacon): Gear review of Ortovox Diract Voice beacon with spoken search instructions
- [G3 Acquired by Canadawide Sports](https://offpistemag.com/g3-aquired-by-canadawide-sports): Industry news on G3 Genuine Guide Gear acquisition by Canadawide Sports
- [Winter 2025-26 Forecast - La Niña Chances on the Rise](https://offpistemag.com/winter-2025-26-forecast): NOAA winter snow forecast predicting weak La Niña conditions for 2025-26
- [Climbing Skin Reglue Service](https://offpistemag.com/climbing-skin-reglue-service-big-sky-mountain-products): BSMP's professional climbing skin reglue service using Ascension tech

## Mountain Culture & Media

- [Swift. Silent. Deep - The Legacy of the Jackson Hole Air Force](https://offpistemag.com/swift-silent-deep-jackson-hole-air-force): Film review of Jackson Hole Air Force documentary on 1980s freeride culture
- [Training for the Uphill Athlete](https://offpistemag.com/the-uphill-athlete): Book review of Steve House's training manual for ski mountaineering
